title: [Experiment] causal-geometry-discrete-b300: Causal geometry and discrete state features on B300
body:
# [Experiment] causal-geometry-discrete-b300: Causal geometry and discrete state features on B300

1. **Status, lineage and owner.** This is a research draft with an implemented fresh H512×1 training path, indexed feature masks, optional guarded adapter-only continuation, eight-card measured profile gate and frozen 120-fit/15-wave launch matrix. The B300 packet has **zero B300 profiles, zero B300 matrix fits and zero B300 optimizer steps**; root’s separate local R1 feature-versus-zero comparison and adaptive R2 frozen-adapter probe are reported as prior evidence and are not part of this packet’s matrix. Hypotheses: H-CAUSAL-GEOMETRY-DISCRETE-B300-20261018-R1, child of H-MOMENT-GEOMETRY-20261017-R1 and H-DISCRETE-OCCUPANCY-20261017-R1; experiment: E-CAUSAL-GEOMETRY-DISCRETE-B300-20261018-R1. Branch experiment/causal-geometry-b300 is based on research-team SHA e9a4c16c848e09d87d279a3dd64d7db376a8551d; shared-policy ancestor is origin/main SHA 0f4796609781da2b0886e2c5f9c52139987ba120. Core feature/trainer source was selectively copied from dirty local main commit 35cf36a337a23ecc0e86159a5cb1867a851ac06e. The optional `feature_adapter.py` guard was copied separately from root’s dirty post-R2 helper; the portable R2 training receipts do not capture that run’s exact pre-guard source revision. No root logs, local admission records, data, checkpoints or predictions were copied. The branch includes serving source commits bdf996f9d1040936e2f84c837a39fc39e7431e40 and ce5f8f63c1c495dac3c7f4a3ce46226b6efd7aba, channel-order correction 03e6db635977d9514f46ec990738112075c588de, indexed evidence 04252f6a35bc99711edf57397b775b66f6f11fe3, and callback reset-compatibility fix 52e7ed6bb6f5861846bb11eac29ceeaf3669dc0b. The B300 compute owner owns future profiles/fits; root owns the separate local R1/R2 direction probes and R3 F0/seed3 block/scale follow-up. None counts as a B300 cell or an independent seed replication. The R2 q16x native endpoint has since been graded on all exposed F0, but its adapter training result remains below the fixed parent and does not count as B300 evidence. Its exact-ZIP Python 3.11 smoke and signed-zero-sensitive same-precision replay passed; the predeclared FP32 native/Torch tolerance failed and the cause is unisolated. See the [source-indexed receipt bundle](prior_evidence/root_adapter_probe_r2_native_q16x/README.md).

2. **Why it should work.** Sampled raw EDA shows arcs and near-arcs in some per-sequence mean/variance summaries, with exact levels and long dwell runs in selected channels. Bounded or discrete-support mixtures can generate arc-like moment relationships, but this is not evidence for a universal circle, periodicity, market regime or physical meaning. The proposed 60 channels give a recurrent model explicit causal moment, arc-residual, anchor occupancy, current-level identity, row-occupancy, event-share and dwell summaries while retaining the raw/event input. The strongest alternative is that extra channels perturb optimization or parameterization and apparent changes are seed/slice noise. The four equal-width masks keep input rank and parameter count fixed while isolating the 20-channel continuous block, 40-channel discrete block and their interaction.

3. **Compute advantage.** Eight B300s can train eight independent small GRUs concurrently; each card handles one arm and one fold/seed cell. There is no DDP for these fits. The frozen matrix entails 120 fits and 5,371,320 planned optimizer updates. An eight-card H512×1 profile measures actual per-card update timing, finite gradients, CPU RSS and CUDA allocated/reserved memory before any matrix fit; no B300 wall time is guessed. A positive block or interaction would justify separately measured scale/context work and teacher/student follow-up. The guarded warm adapter path is implemented, but its one exposed F0/seed3 R2 probe was negative versus its fixed parent. Broader warm continuation, larger GRU teacher scaling, teacher-only/student-only/both-feature factorials and geometry-feature distillation remain separate paths that need matched fold-clean ancestry and their own profiles. The canonical trainer supports feature and GRU size flags; this packet does not implement the teacher cache/factorial runner. For a warm test, require a matching fold-clean parent for each of the30 fold/seed identities; a single F0 parent must never initialize other folds. Larger teachers may use torchrun/DDP only if their own measured profile justifies it.

4. **Frozen comparison.** Four fresh-from-scratch GRU H512×1 arms share identical data membership, 271-wide model input, seed-bound initialization and sequence order. All use train+valid under the frozen CampaignSplit, fitting-only geometry priors, 3 epochs, fixed epoch2, batch8 sequences, 2000-row chunks, wmse, AdamW, OneCycle, LR0.001, weight decay0.01, gradient clip1, deterministic mode, and no evaluation during fit. The official endpoint is produced afterward by feature-only prediction on that manifest's fixed held-out groups and unchanged global_wp_clip2_v1 grading. Expected updates per fit from the frozen R4 plan are F0 44,760, F1 44,790, F2 44,850 and F3 44,640; compare actual profile and terminal histories to these before interpreting. Neural inputs, parameters, activations, recurrent state, loss, gradients and optimizer state are FP32, with autocast, GradScaler and TF32 disabled and float32 matmul precision set to highest. The causal geometry statistics/counts are accumulated in FP64 and the 60 final channels are cast to FP32; the official metric retains its canonical FP64-centered accumulation. All arms compute the same feature transform and fitting prior; only indexed visibility masks differ. Reset the feature state for every sequence and preserve the model's usual hidden-state reset.

5. **Thirty paired runs.** Every arm receives all30 identities; matrix.json lists every pair and every GPU-slot assignment for all15 eight-fit waves. Pair index i maps to fold i mod4 and seed 1001+floor(i/4): F0 and F1 each use seeds1001–1008, F2 and F3 use seeds1001–1007. Thus there are8/8/7/7 cells per fold and30 per arm. Each wave uses consecutive pair indices 2w and2w+1; GPU slots0–3 run baseline/moments/dictionary/combined for pair A, and slots4–7 run those arms for pair B. Baseline zeros indices0–59; moments keeps0–19 and zeros20–59; dictionary keeps20–59 and zeros0–19; combined keeps0–59. These are true indexed masks, not a suffix-width approximation. The initial eight-card profile is a separate engineering activity and does not count toward the120 fits. All folds are exposed or potentially exposed. No teacher or initializer is used in this fresh matrix.

6. **Validation and significance.** Score each fixed endpoint with global_wp_clip2_v1 using the official ±2 prediction/label clipping, fixed scored-row mask and original clipped-label magnitude weights. Primary statistic is the equal-weight mean of four fold-level paired deltas for combined minus baseline. The preregistered secondary family is moments minus baseline, dictionary minus baseline, and the interaction combined − moments − dictionary + baseline. Report two-sided approximate centered seed-bootstrap p-values and Holm adjustment across these four contrasts. For each 10,000-draw seed bootstrap, sample the eight seed identities with replacement and reuse the same multiplicities across folds; renormalize over available seeds within each fold, redraw if any fold has zero sampled weight. Record the fixed RNG seed 20261018. Report the percentile95% interval, all four fold means/ranges and all paired seed deltas. Separately hold fits fixed and resample source-qualified evaluation components within each fold, using the same component multiplicities for every arm and seed in that fold; report this conditional component interval separately. Eight seed identities are few and all folds are exposed; intervals and p-values are approximate and do not support a fresh-regime claim. A zero-crossing interval alone does not reject the mechanism.

7. **Leakage and coverage.** The four committed split manifests bind source-qualified train/valid groups and held-out components. The model fits only each manifest's fitting groups; outer evaluation is invoked only after the fixed checkpoint is saved. Arc coefficients, anchor atoms and the top-three exact-level vocabularies are fit from fitting rows for each cell, with a deterministic tie break. Feature values are prefix-causal, include no future label or full-sequence statistic, and reset at each sequence boundary. All four validation folds have been seen or may have been seen in earlier geometry work; they remain exposed development evidence. Anonymous source encodings and sparse visual sampling do not establish physical semantics or future-regime coverage. Root’s separate local R1/R2 direction probes, two R3 F0/seed3 block fits, and four inference-only R2 alpha aliases are outside the matrix and cannot count as B300 cells or independent seed replications; all local variants reuse the same exposed F0/seed3 lineage, and one F0 parent cannot initialize another fold. Native build/ABI and synthetic 20,000-row event/geometry/prediction/reset parity passed after a retained first failure and correction. The separate R2 q16x endpoint scored 0.6804519697 across all 468 exposed F0 groups; exact-ZIP Python 3.11 smoke and an eight-group, signed-zero-sensitive same-precision cache replay passed. Its predeclared FP32 native/Torch tolerance failed (287,989/318,416 values outside threshold; max absolute error 0.0007533; mean 0.0000555); `Activations::Fast` is used and the cause was not isolated. The R3 α=−0.50 inference alias (same R2 fit) later scored 0.6814234038 in a direct q16x native replay across all 468 exposed F0 groups; it has no public score and no Torch-equivalence claim. Exact-ZIP Python 3.11 smoke, static ABI, archive integrity and synthetic A-B-A reset checks passed. Its measured 38.09-minute callback-only projection over 39.4M rows is not complete competition runtime or a target-host guarantee. See the separate [R2](prior_evidence/root_adapter_probe_r2_native_q16x/README.md) and [R3](prior_evidence/root_geometry_variations_r3/README.md) receipt bundles.

8. **Decision-changing result.** A +0.001 absolute WP change is a useful effect reference, not a kill threshold. A positive combined-minus-baseline result with compatible fold behavior and separate component uncertainty would keep the feature family active and motivate a distinct fold-clean warm/teacher/student follow-up. A positive dictionary block or interaction can justify target/mixture work even if the fresh combined model is not best standalone. A negative/noisy fresh H512 result narrows this exact recipe. Root’s R2 frozen-adapter and the two matched R3 block-only adapter fits scored below their fixed parent on the same exposed F0/seed3 lineage; this narrows those short recipes, not the feature family. The inference-only alpha screen nominated alpha=−0.50 at +0.0001956 versus parent, but its conditional component interval crosses zero and excludes alpha selection, seed, fold and public-transfer uncertainty. Its exact q16x native endpoint later scored 0.6814234 on the same exposed F0; that direct served result records packaging/runtime behavior, not a new fit or selection-adjusted gain. The R2 q16x endpoint itself scored 0.6804519697 versus its parent at 0.6812265132; its +0.0000021 Torch-reference difference is a precision-level endpoint difference, not a training gain. A broader family, materially different warm recipe, teacher target, feature-only student, distillation or fixed mixture remains untested. Preserve all negative and inconclusive cells. Do not add a local delta to public score. The separate R2 q16x ZIP was submitted by the user and returned 0.66428 (submission 14s6l2z7), 0.00404 below the then-reported team best; this does not score the R3 aliases or support a feature-family conclusion.

9. **How to run.** Use the exact mount table and commands in [LAUNCH.md](LAUNCH.md). Check out this branch at its published source SHA into a clean project root, bind supplied train/valid parquet and four canonical NPZ caches read-only at the paths named there, bind writable persistent cache/artifact volumes, mount four fold-specific portable source registries read-only, and export WNN_B300_SCRATCH to writable physical disk. Run uv sync --locked and require an empty git status. First invoke scripts/geometry_b300/profile_all.sh, which runs two warmup and eight measured updates concurrently on eight single-card B300 workers and seals profile_receipt.json only if source, unique device IDs, overlap, strict precision, finite updates, time and memory evidence agree. Inspect that receipt and the complete optimizer-update budget before launching. Then run the15 commands represented by the shell loop in LAUNCH.md; each calls launch_wave.sh for two adjacent pair indices and starts exactly one independent fit on each card. The cell runner validates the explicit matrix, source SHA, split, portable input identities and mount modes (six source inputs plus the selected fold registry read-only; persistent cache/artifact volumes mounted read-write at their exact targets; physical scratch read-write and not RAM-backed), uses the canonical trainer/predictor/grader, records phase commands and hashes, resumes only from training_state.pt at an epoch boundary, and preserves failures. The launcher skips terminal cells on a partial-wave restart. No queue manager or remote data service is introduced.

10. **Evidence to return.** Each profile/cell receipt binds source, config, device, fold, seed, arm, profile, exact commands, phase times, logs and artifact hashes. Canonical history/provenance should retain progress, update attempts, learning rates, preclip gradient diagnostics, fixed checkpoint, training state, official score and prediction sidecar/hash. Return all cells and exclusions, prediction/grade manifests and actual measured time/memory/update data. Make separate evidence and weights archives, hash every file and each archive, and store them in approved private storage. The evidence archive contains receipts, logs, histories, provenance, scores, predictions and portable source registries; the weights archive contains fixed epoch2 model files and continuation states. Do not archive supplied data or credentials.

11. **Results and trace.** No B300 profile, matrix fit or grade is present in this draft. Root-owned local evidence remains outside the B300 matrix and is indexed in the [unified geometry note](../../unified/ideas/CAUSAL_GEOMETRY_DISCRETE_B300_20261018_R1.md) and [prior evidence index](prior_evidence/README.md). The R1 feature-versus-zero pair and R2 frozen-adapter fit are negative for their exact one-exposed-F0/seed3 recipes; R2 scored 0.6804499040 versus its fixed parent at 0.6812265132 (delta −0.0007766092, conditional component-bootstrap 95% interval [−0.0013528215,−0.0002791334]). The R3 follow-up added two matched adapter-only block fits (5,120 attempted/completed updates each): moments-only scored 0.6808680243 (−0.0003584889 vs parent) and dictionary-only 0.6806168661 (−0.0006096471). A separate inference-only scale grid reused the R2 checkpoint; alpha=−0.50 scored 0.6814221100, +0.0001955968 vs parent, with a conditional component-bootstrap 95% interval [−0.0000247976,+0.0004214279] that crosses zero. This alias was adaptively nominated on exposed F0 and is not an independent fit; the interval does not cover alpha-selection, fitting-seed, fold or transfer uncertainty. The exact alias q16x endpoint replay has completed: it directly scored 0.6814234038 over all 468 exposed F0 groups (9.36M rows; 808,863 scored rows). The 5,323,608-byte ZIP hash is `27f01f53ba32f7256ce1663e8b163b382e673fc96e7870fdebdf310d4886f98e`; its release manifest, build, static ABI, Python 3.11 smoke, A-B-A reset and full-F0 receipts are in the [R3 evidence bundle](prior_evidence/root_geometry_variations_r3/README.md). This remains an adaptively selected served alias from the same exposed F0/seed3 lineage, with no public score and no Torch-equivalence claim; local full competition runtime remains unmeasured. The original R2 q16x ZIP is 5,323,200 bytes, SHA-256 955bff715871ff8a977d96a43f4edb89b1f5ecec72ae8ee49c0c2b53a3b6688b; it scored 0.6804519697 on all 468 exposed F0 groups in native q16x versus Torch 0.6804499040. Exact-ZIP Python 3.11 smoke and signed-zero-sensitive same-precision cache replay passed; the predeclared FP32 native/Torch tolerance failed, with cause unisolated and no relaxed threshold. The user submitted that separate R2 ZIP: the portal reported WP 0.66428 in 1,847 seconds with 626 MB, versus a then-reported team best of 0.66832 (−0.00404); this is a public result for that endpoint, not for R3 or the feature family. Receipts are in [prior_evidence/root_adapter_probe_r2_native_q16x](prior_evidence/root_adapter_probe_r2_native_q16x/README.md). The draft PR is [#15](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/15); its original publication source SHA is fafe38e262992e6f62c1dbf8439e24b9bfb65943. The packet catalogue (../README.md) preserves that snapshot and the live branch records later evidence. No merge or B300 fit/profile is part of this proposal.
